title: Naughty Juice Butterscotch Yum Yum Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Butterscotch Yum Yum from Naughty Juice is as sweet and decadent as vapes get, thanks to the irresistible taste of rich and velvety butterscotch drizzled over a freshly-baked, comforting doughnut pastry, glazed in a crisp sugar shell. Sheer indulgence doesn't get much tastier than this. These premium shortfill bottles contain 100ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 20ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create an e-liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill will give you 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure to shake the contents of the shortfill bottle well to combine. E-liquids in Shortfills are a great way to make your favourite e-liquid last longer, saving you money and trips online and to your local Vapestore to resupply. These e-liquids tend to be high in VG (vegetable glycerin) and are best suited to high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits with low-resistance coils to achieve the best flavour and vapour production from your e-liquid. Naughty Juices are a premium collection of dessert and dairy flavoured e-liquids, available in long-lasting shortfill bottles. Inspired by outrageously delicious, sweet treats and decadent desserts, every Naughty Juice bottle is loaded with expertly crafted flavours for the ultimate in vaping indulgence.
